root.label: Biden speaks with families of missing Americans after October 7 attack

events.label: Biden speaks with families of missing Americans after October 7 attack

slots.name: call duration
slots.sentence: And that call was scheduled on the president's calendar for half-hour or so. It went on for I think almost an hour-and-a-half.

slots.name: call date
slots.sentence: Well, it was a few days after the attack. He had a call with the families of American missing, and -- because we didn't know who was alive, who was dead.
